decision_question: Is this integrated geometry a material source-alignment gain, and which largest gaps prevent full photoreal likeness?
decision_scope: continuation only; current parent-provided eight-hour/200k architect authorization; no release
acceptance_criteria: Compact rounded shield shoulder exposing flank
actual_gains: Swept layered crown replaces the more blunt hood.
Curved neck replaces the straight segmented column.
Shorter rounded shield reduces hanging-wing mass and exposes more flank.
regressions: The extended horizontal lower jaw is more spear-like and less source-aligned than the prior downward lower-bill contour.
New large shoulder slabs create a coarse lumpy shingle surface; compactness improved more than construction likeness.

claims.claim: The integrated geometry makes a material source-alignment gain over the frozen baseline in the viewed neutral camera.
claims.consequence: Rejecting all geometry would discard useful crown, neck and shield improvements.
claims.next_test: Retain these changes and compare next same-camera geometry correction against both this checkpoint and source.

claims.claim: Swept crown, curved neck and compact shoulder improve three requested features, while the face still lacks the reference head identity.
claims.consequence: Feature presence could be mistaken for resolved source likeness.
claims.next_test: Use a matched July head crop and candidate profile/three-quarter to compare crown envelope, brow angle, optic depth, bill-root volume and cheek opening.

claims.claim: Billroot/cheek construction and horizontal spear-like lower jaw are the largest remaining identity difference.
claims.consequence: The bird retains a generic segmented prop face despite the improved crown.
claims.next_test: Replace the large empty angular cheek wedges with curved surrounding hardware and a deeper integrated bill root; shorten and curve the lower jaw downward using July head-only evidence. Re-render exact neutral head camera.

claims.claim: The neck now curves, but its hard collar-like segments and narrow transition still do not form the source continuous layered throat-to-breast sweep.
claims.consequence: The head, neck and breast continue to read as assembled separate volumes.
claims.next_test: Continue plate rows through the lower neck into the breast and soften the abrupt cylindrical throat-to-egg-shell junction without changing stance anchors. Review silhouette and neutral close-up.

claims.claim: The shortened rounded shoulder is a gain; large rectangular raised plates and the blunt lower termination remain unlike the overlapping tapered compact shield.
claims.consequence: Compactness alone can conceal the loss of an avian shield surface and clear flank articulation.
claims.next_test: Keep the reduced envelope, reshape broad slabs into curved overlapping tapered rows, and show flank machinery beneath a clear shield edge in a matched source/candidate crop.

claims.claim: The candidate still reads as a coherent heavy flightless mechanical bird, but full photoreal source likeness is not achieved.
claims.consequence: A geometry continuation decision could be promoted into full target or release acceptance.
claims.next_test: After major-shape correction, supply source-matched regional finish and adequately exposed intended-light views, then owner artistic review.

claims.claim: Workshop illumination obscures most breast, flank and legs, so it cannot establish intended-light full-bird likeness.
claims.consequence: Darkness may hide blocking differences and falsely suggest cinematic completion.
claims.next_test: Raise or redirect fill/rim enough to read the layered torso and exposed flank while retaining the workshop mood.

claims.claim: Camera identity is reported by the frozen manifest but was not independently verified through Blender receipts in this outcome review.
claims.consequence: Small apparent proportion differences could reflect camera or framing assumptions.
claims.next_test: Evidence reviewer verifies camera, lighting and exposure receipts; do not infer exact source dimensions from these images.

limitations: One reviewer using the same model family; visual judgments are independent of worker conclusions and previous critiques.
Seven images inspected; no turntable, animation, era completion, browser, local build, deployment or engineering claim evaluated.
July body and wings excluded from judgment; only head identity used.
Finish remains visibly broad and simplified, but this checkpoint explicitly has no new finish claim.
Source camera is estimated; exact source-camera likeness remains an inference.
review_expiry_trigger: Any frozen input hash changes or new geometry/render evidence.
follow_up_owner: root integrator; artistic acceptance belongs to owner
